question: What is the name and id of the department with the most number of degrees ?

subgoal:

Required outputs: department name; department id
Filters: Consider departments that have one or more associated degree records.; If multiple departments tie for the largest number of degrees, return all tied departments.
Sort/limit: order by descending degree count; no fixed numeric limit (return all ties for top count)

verifier_reason: The view provides per-department degree counts with department_id and department_name exposed, has appropriate grain (one row per department), correct lineage (Departments and Degree_Programs), and no intrinsic filters or time-windows. It counts degree_program_id so departments with zero degrees appear with count 0; the sub-goal requires considering departments with one or more associated degree records — that filter can be applied on top of this view. The aggregation level and operators match the need to find department(s) with the largest degree_count. Therefore this view can be safely reused.
